title: About us
description: Learn the purpose and editorial approach behind Little Home Ideas.
body:
Why we're here

Small ideas. Better living.

We believe the most useful home ideas are clear, achievable and honest about what they can—and cannot—do.

Practical over perfect

Little Home Ideas is an independent collection of home, garden and DIY inspiration for real spaces and budgets. We focus on small changes, renter-conscious options and helpful decision-making tools.

How we work

Articles may be drafted with AI assistance. We aim to review factual and safety-sensitive claims and to disclose when products have not been independently tested. Read our editorial policy.

Start exploring

Browse all ideas or try our patio privacy planner.

title: Privacy information
description: Privacy information for visitors to Little Home Ideas.
body:
Privacy information

Last updated: October 22, 2026.

Little Home Ideas publishes home and garden guides and provides browser-based patio layout and tile planning tools.

Hosting and technical logs

This website is served through GitHub Pages. GitHub may process IP addresses and request data to deliver the site, maintain security, and operate its services. See GitHub's privacy statement.

Optional Google Analytics

With your permission, we load Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, useful articles, and use of the planner. Before you choose Allow analytics, our consent controller does not load Google's analytics library or send analytics events. Rejecting analytics does not affect access to articles or tools.

After consent, Google receives information such as page visits, timestamps, browser and device information, referral sources, cookie identifiers, and technical request data including your IP address. Google processes this information according to its service settings and policies. Data may be processed outside your country. See Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from partner sites.

Our explicit events measure article opens, saved guides, scroll milestones, and planner start, completed layout, save, and print actions. Our custom events do not include floor dimensions, furniture positions, search text, email addresses, or other form answers. The page URLs sent by our code omit query strings and fragments. Enhanced measurement is switched off in our Analytics stream. Google Signals and user-provided data collection are also switched off. Detailed location and device collection remains enabled, which can include city-level location and device metadata. Analytics advertising personalization is disabled for all regions.

We rely on your consent for optional analytics. User-level and event-level Analytics data have a two-month retention setting, with resetting on new user activity switched off. This setting does not limit the retention of most standard aggregated reports.

Your choice and cookies

Choose Allow analytics or Reject analytics in the banner. We remember your choice in this browser's local storage for up to 180 days. You can reopen Analytics choices in the footer to change it. Withdrawing permission stops our analytics collection, removes accessible Google Analytics cookies, and reloads the page. Withdrawal does not erase data already collected by Google.

After permission, Google Analytics uses cookies such as _ga and a property-specific _ga cookie to distinguish visits and sessions. Our tag requests a 180-day cookie lifetime without extending it on each visit; your browser may apply a shorter lifetime. Advertising storage, advertising user data, and advertising personalization are denied by our integration. We do not enable Google Signals. No advertising or affiliate tracking scripts have been installed by us.

Planner, search, and saved ideas

The planner calculations and site search run locally. Patio layouts are saved in browser storage only when you choose Save in this browser. Saved layouts include measurements, furniture and opening positions, rotations, locks, a name you enter, and a save date. They are not uploaded or synchronized. You can remove individual saved layouts in the planner, download a layout file as a backup, or clear website storage in your browser settings. Opening a downloaded layout reads that file locally. Tile-plan downloads contain the measurements and estimates shown in the tool. Our custom analytics events report tool actions, not the values you enter. Saved article identifiers and your analytics preference are stored on your device. Saved ideas are not synchronized between devices. Remove a saved guide with its bookmark button, or clear website storage in your browser settings. Clearing the analytics preference makes the site ask again.

Operator and contact details

Little Home Ideas is operated by Miroslav Uličný, a sole trader registered in Slovakia, who is responsible for the processing of personal data described in this notice.

Business address: Zombova 1299/13, 040 23 Košice-Sídlisko KVP, Slovakia.
Business identification number (IČO): 46792422.
Trade Register: District Office Košice (Okresný úrad Košice), registration no. 820-73061.
Privacy contact: info@littlehomeideas.com. You can also use our contact form.

Your privacy rights

Where applicable under data protection law, you may request access to, correction or deletion of your personal data, restriction of processing, or data portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You can withdraw analytics consent at any time through Analytics choices in the footer without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. Contact us using the details above to exercise your rights. You may also complain to the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic or another competent supervisory authority.

title: Advertising & affiliate disclosure
description: Current advertising and affiliate disclosure for Little Home Ideas.
body:
Transparency

Advertising & affiliate disclosure

Our current advertising status and editorial standards.

Current status

Little Home Ideas does not currently contain affiliate links or paid advertising placements.

Our disclosure standard

Any commercial relationship must be identified clearly near the relevant content. A product link or image must not be presented as independent product testing unless that testing occurred.

Editorial independence

Paid relationships must not be presented as independent product testing. See our editorial policy.

title: Editorial policy
description: How Little Home Ideas develops practical and responsible home and garden content.
body:
Our editorial approach

We want home improvement ideas to be useful, clear about limitations, and practical for real budgets and living situations.

What we aim to publish

Step-by-step explanations, comparisons, design inspiration and small interactive tools. We distinguish general suggestions from claims that require measurements, expert review or real-world testing.

Safety first

Projects involving structural loads, electricity, plumbing, elevated balconies, building codes or other significant hazards may require permission or professional guidance. Our content is not a substitute for qualified advice.

Product and price claims

We do not describe products as personally tested unless that testing actually occurred. Indicative prices, when included, should be dated and supported by current sources. Readers should verify availability and compatibility independently.

AI-assisted drafting

Drafting and research may be assisted by AI. Material facts, safety claims, sources and editorial quality should be reviewed before publication. We will correct significant errors when identified.

Advertising and affiliate relationships

We currently have no affiliate links or advertisements on this website. If these are added, we will clearly disclose commercial relationships and keep editorial recommendations separate from paid placements.

Images and illustrations

Decorative scenes illustrate design ideas rather than documenting independently tested projects or before-and-after results. Planning drawings are schematic and do not replace measurements or engineering advice. For third-party photographs, we require a verified license allowing free use for the intended purpose, with a linked source and any required attribution. Public accessibility alone is not permission to reuse an image.
